mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces discount rates applied to equity valuations and increases equity attractiveness relative to fixed income, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% and average 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration and economic slowdown, triggering risk-off behavior that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% and average 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds its 4-quarter moving average and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains below 2.5%, the market interprets this as a favorable growth-inflation environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 4QMA and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% and average 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (defined by UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth above 2% year-over-year), the market anticipates policy tightening and economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and GDPC1 growth > 2% (yoy) and average 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening economic activity, triggering risk-off behavior that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and average 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 105 and average 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in year-over-year inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL yoy inflation > 2.5% and average 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 1.0%, it signals a tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with restrictive monetary policy
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and average 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in a 3-year rolling window.
